docs/compact-reference.docs/cli-reference.md:
# CLI reference

## /compact

Compacts the current transcript.

### Manual compaction

Run `/compact` to compact immediately.

### Automatic compaction

The session compacts on its own when the transcript approaches the context limit. A banner appears when this happens.

issues.title: JavaScript heap out of memory after long sessions
issues.author: kbrennan
issues.body:
After roughly four hours in a large workspace the process dies with `FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed`.

Memory climbs steadily and never comes back down, even when the session is idle. Restarting clears it until it happens again.

Heap snapshot shows the transcript buffer holding every tool result for the whole session.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Bisected to the transcript buffer never being trimmed. We keep every tool result so the transcript view can scroll to the start.

issues.title: Add shell completion for zsh
issues.author: tsato
issues.body: Bash completion works but zsh users have to tab through nothing. Would be happy to send a PR if someone points me at where the command list is generated.

issues.title: Context auto-compact never triggers on large repos
issues.author: lgrant
issues.body:
On a monorepo checkout the auto-compact banner appears several turns after the context is already full, so the session degrades before anything is compacted.

On a small repo it fires when you would expect. It looks like the trigger is reading a token estimate that does not include the tool results appended in the same turn.

issues.title: Slow startup on Windows
issues.author: aruiz
issues.body: Cold start takes about nine seconds on Windows against roughly two on macOS. Warm start is fine.
